response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with strong full-stack, systems, and DLang expertise, but the resume shows minimal Java exposure (robotics/tooling projects years ago) and no Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or JVM-focused tooling work. The core technical requirements of this role — deep JVM/Java/Kotlin expertise and enterprise framework experience — are not demonstrated, making this a poor fit despite strong general engineering skills.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Some prior IDE-adjacent work (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI IDE)
Strong track record of ownership, architecture, testing practices (TDD), and technical leadership
concerns: No evidence of Kotlin experience at all
No Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience listed in skills or work history
Java experience is minimal, dated, and not tied to enterprise frameworks or JVM tooling

key_factors.factor: No Kotlin and minimal/dated Java experience
Strong general engineering and IDE-adjacent (C IDE) background
